quest.title: Subterranean Ruins
quest.description: The crucial moment is fast approaching. You should get some rest today...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Return to the Weary Inn to rest

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You slowly fall asleep to the sound of Paimon's snoring...

talks.objective: Return to the Weary Inn to rest

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Where am I? Is this... the Night Kingdom?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (How did I get here? I was just... Argh...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I feel dizzy, like I can't think straight. Let me try to take a look around...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (When I passed through the wall of light, it felt like my whole body was frozen.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I guess the Lord of the Night's protection can't reach this place. The cold and darkness are suffocating, and all I hear are cries of exhaustion and pain.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (How long have these souls existed in torment? How much longer before it ends...?)

dialogues.speaker: "The Captain"
dialogues.text: Though our homeland has become a distant memory, the flames of war continue to rage. We have long shed the last of our blood...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What is The Captain doing here? And what is he saying...?)

dialogues.speaker: "The Captain"
dialogues.text: One day, I will deliver you to the place I promised.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}! Did you have a nightmare last night?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon could hear you tossing and turning in your sleep. Maybe you're just nervous for the final battle?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (So, it was a dream? I can barely remember it.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Everything that happened seems so hazy. Trying to remember is giving me a headache...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Just shake it off, {NICKNAME}! We're supposed to meet with Mavuika today!
